content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Manager (UG Programs): Graduation degree (Master's preferred); Minimum 6 years overall experience with 3 years relevant in academic administration in Higher Education/Management Institution; Proficiency in MS Excel, Database Management & MS Office tools. Associate Manager (UG Programs): Graduation degree (Master's preferred); Minimum 5 years overall experience with 2 years relevant in academic administration in Higher Education/Management Institution; Proficiency in MS Excel, Database Management & MS Office tools.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIM Mumbai Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Mumbai to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026 is 05 October 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Manager and Associate Manager posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the recruitment drive, with one post for Manager (UG Programs) and one post for Associate Manager (UG Programs).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduation degree, with a Master's degree being preferred. Relevant experience in academic administration is also a key requirement.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 45 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India rules for eligible categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Rs. 590/-. SC/ST candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Scrutiny/Screening of Applications, followed by a Written Test, Skill Test, Interview, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 47600 to Rs. 177500 Per Month, with specific pay levels for Manager and Associate Manager roles.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the job type for these positions is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article. It is highly recommended to read it thoroughly.

faq.question: Q10. What is the start date for the online application?
faq.answer: The online application process for the IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026 begins on 15 September 2026.
